Careful block tips for treat supplies
Start here
Treat Supplies for Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers preparing with Aurelia Skyways should keep pet items orderly and easy to inspect. A calm, well packed supply bag helps the journey proceed smoothly and reduces stress for both the traveler and the animal.

Before departure, review the instructions shared by the passenger coordinator and keep all travel papers together. <<FACT F087>> Place treat supplies in a secure container that closes firmly, and keep them separate from liquids, sharp items, and loose packaging. This helps the welcome team check the bag quickly and supports a smooth boarding process.

During the trip, use only familiar treats in modest amounts so the pet remains settled. Keep the container within easy reach, and avoid opening it in crowded or noisy areas. If the pet travels with a companion, coordinate with the crew so the treats are available when needed and handled safely.

For arrival, keep the travel bag near you until the passenger coordinator gives further direction. <<FACT F107>> If the animal needs a calm pause after landing, keep the treats sealed until you are in the designated pickup area. This simple habit can help the pet remain comfortable and prevent unnecessary disruption.

If you need further guidance, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for more help.
